results.title: Morph Swap

results.name: hw-box-label

results.name: slit-scan-reveal
results.title: Slit Scan Reveal
results.description: The frame's rows sample an authored subject at offset times: a canvas painter draws row slices of one pure position function evaluated at t minus offset(row), smearing arrival through time until the offsets collapse to zero and the mark holds coherent.

results.name: hw-arrow
results.title: Hand-Drawn Arrow
results.description: Wobbled draw-on arrow with straight, gentle, and swoop curve poses, a four-way stroke texture matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray), and a travel-aligned head-arrival stretch pulse with spring recovery; boils while on screen

results.name: ascii-render-pass
results.title: ASCII Render Pass
results.description: A slotted scene renders as live ASCII: a canvas samples the source's luminance grid (rasterized once at mount) and draws glyphs from a density ramp charset; resolution steps coarse to fine as the piece resolves, then holds legible-fine.

results.name: iris-reveal
results.title: Iris Reveal
results.description: A circle clip-path opens from an authored origin revealing state B over state A in one confident pass, then holds on B. Classic register dims and desaturates the before state so the after state lands in full color; a thin accent rim rides the iris edge. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

results.name: hw-callout-circle
results.title: Scribble Callout Circle
results.description: Wobbled ellipse draws around a target with optional scribble fill and curved connector; the handwritten label pops in WITH momentum and the drawn shapes absorb the arrival with a volume-preserving contact squash; outline and connector take the family stroke matrix (plain/soft/sharp/spray); boils
